name: Sunshine Superior
beschreibung: The Sunshine Superior is centrally located in Kappl within the Paznaun Valley, just a short stroll from the ski slopes. The property pairs traditional Tyrolean architecture with contemporary comforts and boasts panoramic views of the surrounding peaks. Guests can look forward to spacious rooms, a welcoming lounge, and a restaurant serving delightful regional cuisine. The setting is ideal for skiing and hiking getaways, offering seamless access to the Kappl-Silvretta ski domain.
